title: Silas and the Letter
author: P. M. Eriksen
blurb: Marguerite Quintana, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
